english.note: Use 副主席 as the general organizational title when the president is called 主席.

exampleSentences.english: Mrs. Lee was elected vice president of the chamber of commerce, and she will take over if the president's post becomes vacant.
exampleSentences.traditional: 李太當選商會副主席，主席出缺時由佢暫代。
